_meta.hepa_licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 - imported from .claude/hepa-src at run time, never vendored
deltas_from_clone_actual: patch size held at P=16 at every rung, so n_tokens scales with context (PREREG 2.2) -- a longer context therefore ALSO buys more tokens; no rung comparison here is a clean test of history alone.

devices.cpu: torch 2.14.0 CPU on Apple M1 Pro (8 cores). Reference family; reproduces REPRODUCIBILITY.md on FD001 and ETTm1 @512.
devices.mps: torch 2.14.0 Apple-GPU backend. ~10-40x faster at the 8192 rung; the ONLY family in which 8192 was reachable in wall-clock. Different float kernels => different numbers; see the measured cpu-vs-mps offset in the report.

_meta.no_gpu_cluster: CSF3 was NOT reachable from this machine: `ssh csf3` fails DNS resolution (nodename nor servname provided). Every number here is local Apple silicon.
_meta.runner: .claude/scratch/hepa-lh-sweep/run_hepa.py -- imports hepa.data/hepa.model/hepa.training/hepa.evaluation; no loader, model, training loop or metric reimplemented.

npz_schema.p_surface: (N,K) float16 cast of the float32 CDF. Recomputing h_auroc from the fp16 dump agrees with the recorded float32 value to <=2.0e-4 (measured on FD001 and GECCO).
npz_schema.t_index: (N,) int32, within-entity cut index t (the EventDataset start)
npz_schema.realised_context: (N,) int32 = min(t_index, rung) -- the ACTUAL history seen, not the rung
npz_schema.meta: json string: dataset, context, seed, norm_mode, hepa_commit

conventions: Degenerate-horizon rule: the SHIPPED CODE's (drop iff n_pos==0 or n_pos==n_total) -- inherited unchanged from hepa.evaluation.metrics.h_auroc, which is imported, not reimplemented.
Horizon conditioning: HEPA's scalar-concat predictor everywhere (PREREG 2.4).
Norm policy as shipped: RevIN for all four sweep datasets; 'none' + global z-score for FD001.
Finetune stopping as shipped: val-loss early stopping everywhere except C-MAPSS (fixed epochs).

not_run.Weather @ 8192: NOT RUN - NOT REACHABLE. ft_val segment is 7704 steps (audit max_available_context = 2048).

not_run.SMAP / TEP / VIX: NOT RUN - out of scope, PREREG section 6.
not_run.ETTm1 @ 8192 (cpu family): NOT RUN on CPU - abandoned for wall-clock after 55 min produced pretrain + 1 finetune epoch (~30 min/epoch, 2 concurrent jobs). Measured on MPS instead (475 s). Reported honestly as a device substitution, not as a null.
not_run.PSM @ 8192 (cpu family): NOT RUN on CPU - same reason as ETTm1 @ 8192. Measured on MPS.
